finding.evidence: Aucun filtre anti-robot visible devant votre site : un outil automatisé peut tester votre formulaire de connexion des milliers de fois ou scanner vos pages sans être ralenti ni bloqué.
finding.description: Placez un WAF ou CDN devant votre site (ex. Cloudflare Free) ou ajoutez un rate-limiting sur les endpoints sensibles (connexion, formulaires, API).

State the concrete fix and cite a primary source (OWASP, MDN, NIST, PCI DSS, IETF RFC, or the vendor's own advisory).
recommendation.answer: Concrete fix for no-rate-limiting on login/forms/API: add server-side rate-limiting, lock out accounts after a defined number of incorrect password attempts, define a maximum ingress data rate limit then drop connections above that rate, and log all failures and alert administrators when credential stuffing/brute force is detected or suspected.

fix.summary: Add per-IP sliding-window throttle (30/min) with 429+Retry-After, rate-limit headers and logging.
fix.risk: A burst of >30 requests in 60s now gets 429; normal 12-page visits still pass.
